idea-plugin.name: Chromatic Codes Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Preview Phoenix Chromatic Codes, a minecraft mod allowing you to use custom color codes, directly in your files.

  • Gutter color previews: a swatch next to every line that uses a chromatic code (&z, §^, &[wave]). Click it to change the color; for gradients, edit the start and end colors together. The change is written back to your config.
  • Syntax highlighting: string text is colored to match the in-game result, in Java, Kotlin, JSON lang files, properties, YAML and any other file with string literals.
  • Animated preview: press Alt+Enter on a coded string to see movement and color effects (wave, shake, pulse, rainbow, glitch and more) animated.
  • Code completion: type &[ inside a string to get named effects.
  • Generator tool window: combine a movement with solid, gradient or rainbow colors, name it, preview it live and insert it at the caret. New effects are saved to your config.
  • Custom colors: reads your project's phoenix_chromatic_colors_codes.yaml (or phoenix_chromatic_codes.yaml) so colors and gradients you define are recognized, and reloads when the file changes.
